decisions.decision: Allow ui -> ui imports, guarded by import-x/no-cycle, recorded in ADR tech/0031
decisions.rationale: The ban was never a recorded decision and cost 10 duplicated close controls plus menu.tsx copying dropdown's class string.

decisions.decision: Optimistic delete for boards and columns, reversing two recorded 'deliberately NOT optimistic' decisions
decisions.rationale: ADR domain/0002 governs SERVER-side recovery ('nowhere to recover a deleted record from'); it says nothing about staging a delete in the client cache with a snapshot rollback. User asked for it directly (items 11, 13).

decisions.decision: Comment cleanup runs LAST, after all functional work
decisions.rationale: Cleaning 188 files first, then letting later agents write fresh comments into them, would rebuild the pile. The rule goes in every remaining agent brief instead.

decisions.decision: The comment density cap's threshold is set AFTER the cleanup, from the measured result
decisions.rationale: Setting it first would fail the build on day one; setting it after ratchets what was actually achieved.
